I'd like to hear from legal, credit risk, servicing operations, and financial crime compliance — please each report any unresolved items on your end so we can move toward final authorization.

While reviewing the debtor tape this week, I found that the largest obligor represents 18% of the pool — well above our 10% single-obligor concentration threshold. Credit policy therefore requires a $1,200,000 first-loss reserve to be established before we can close. I should note that my revised concentration worksheet has not yet been entered into the risk system, so this finding wouldn't be visible to the rest of you until I finalize that entry.
